scope: Platforms currently represented in the personal social-media post index. Add another platform only when the corpus or an active publishing task requires it.

authority.rule: If the current client contradicts this cache, the current client wins. Reverify and update this file rather than forcing stale metadata. Account tier/eligibility is runtime personal state and must not be committed here.

counting.rule: Every posted URL is wrapped by t.co and counts as 23 characters regardless of original URL length. Use the platform composer when exact weighted counting is material.

media.supported_summary: photos, GIF, and/or video subject to current client rules

editing.scope_summary: Premium edit applies to original posts and quotes; reverify before relying on it.

comment_reply.evidence: Current LinkedIn client behavior and LinkedIn-hosted public examples support a 1,250-character ceiling; current official general-comment help does not state the numeric limit.

hmmm: LinkedIn's current official general-comment help page does not expose a numeric comment/reply limit; 1,250 is retained as an observed current constraint and must yield to the live composer if it changes.

Platform counting semantics can differ from simple Unicode code-point length. When a draft is near a hard limit, validate against the platform composer or an authoritative platform counter before calling it publishable.
